📖Ten years after the mysterious disappearance of everyone, you unexpectedly receive a note from your former employer, Newtime Co., a once-thriving toy company. Driven by curiosity and a need for answers, you embark on an investigation to uncover what happened. But how is it all connected to the enigmatic Flower?
